notes.title: ProcW Godot edition now available as a launch option!
notes.notes: [p]ProcW Godot Edition has many new features, and will be updated a lot more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NOTE: This only applies to the new Godot edition.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Features include:[/p][list][*][p]Up to four player local multiplayer (can just be Controller VS Controller VS Controller VS Controller now! Keyboard still supported.)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]"End of round multipliers" now toggleable.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In the more stable Godot Engine.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ice Skating mode and Damage from off-screen still both toggleable.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New scoring system.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Store modifier now available, allowing players to pick one of two perks every five rounds for money.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Performance Improvement[/p][/*][*][p]New UI[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy the update.[/p]
